title: Bounded restriction of the recursive affine compactification comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative coefficient ring, S a Noetherian scheme finite type over a field, d a natural number, c a compactification of the ordered affine projection, and M a bounded-below derived etale A-module on the d-th tower scheme. The hom component of reductionEtaleAffineLeftIso A S d c at M.obj equals the hom of orderedCompactificationComparison A k S d c M. These are the specified ambient and bounded comparison constructions, not arbitrary isomorphisms.

proof.text: At zero expand the bounded formalism identity normalization into open and proper identity comparisons. Restriction of their units and counits identifies them with mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekId and rightDerivedLowerStarIdIso. Pairwise comparison restriction and transitivity then give the arbitrary c equation.

For the successor expand both recursive comparisons and affineTracePlusCompatibility. Apply the bounded/unbounded pairwise equation to the standard line comparison and the induction hypothesis at the preceding compactification. Naturality moves the preceding comparison through the line factor.

The bounded/unbounded binary composition equation, with its pairwise conjugations for the chosen compatible triangle, identifies the two compositors. Pairwise transitivity gives the final specified compactification c. All intervening compact-support inputs remain bounded below.

theorem affineCompactificationComparison_normalization
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] [S.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (c : Compactification (affineTraceProjection S d))
    (M : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (affineTraceTower S d).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    (ProEtale.reductionEtaleAffineLeftIso A S d c).hom.app M.obj =
      (orderedCompactificationComparison A k S d c M).hom
